title: dugandiodendron colombianum
intro: Dugandiodendron colombianum, commonly known as the Colombian cedar tree, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant is valued for its wood, which is used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Dugandiodendron colombianum include its potential to reduce inflammation and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans and terpenes, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
